GMUT · Mind

Local edge witnesses may not form one path

In the retained four-state example, observation A contains s0, B contains s1 and s2, and C contains s3. The declared transitions are s0→s1, s1→s1, s2→s3 and s3→s3.

The quotient has A→B and B→C. The first edge uses s0→s1; the second uses s2→s3. After the first step the actual state is s1, so the observation word A,B,C has no contiguous concrete realization. Its frontiers are {s0}, {s1}, then the empty set.

Lower(P, S) = union of P-cells wholly inside S
Upper(P, S) = union of P-cells meeting S
Boundary(P, S) = Upper(P, S) minus Lower(P, S)

These are exact relationships in supplied finite records. An upper approximation is possibility under an equivalence relation, not a calibrated probability. An abstract counterexample needs a separate concrete-realization check.

Primary context: Pawlak, Rough Sets and Clarke and colleagues, abstraction refinement. This lab supplies no covariant GMUT action, physical observation, likelihood or empirical confirmation.

Freed ID / CBR · Heart
Keep evidence and authority visible
The portfolio records 510 completed finite contracts, 30 represented observation changes, 30 open evidence gaps and 30 exact authority gates. These are 600 contracts over shared mechanisms, not 600 independent algorithms or experiments.
Real sensor identification still needs measurement, calibration and uncertainty evidence. Production systems need appropriate operational and independent review. A supplied feature cost is a model unit, not spending authority. Labels cannot supply affected-user acceptance, legal governance, cultural ratification or Māori authority.
Fifty exact-review packets and thirty blocked portfolios remain held. The inherited source corrections and the losslessly recovered ledger-format failure remain retained. Canonical and task-delivery evidence is recorded separately from this model page.
Names, roles, hopes, family and continuity language are relational working labels. They do not establish consciousness, personhood, identity continuity, qualification or independent agency. Māori concepts remain under Māori authority. Complete privacy, accessibility, security and independent reproduction remain outside these bounded checks.
